Maya: Quick sync — planning a dedicated office hours for our Ambassador cohort (Helix Health + NovaCare) next week. Need to lock time + agenda. 60m slot, enablement + migration triage + renewal signal check. Who's available Tue/Wed 9–11am PT? @Sam @Jordan
Sam: I can do Tue 10am PT. Happy to lead the migration triage. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Wed morning ok for me but prefer Tue if Helix needs help pre-QBR. Heads up: Helix flagged perf spikes in last 48h, possible renewal risk. We should loop in AM for pre-call.
Priya: Can we do a quick availability poll? react with :one: for Tue 10am PT, :two: for Wed 9:30am PT. I'll collect.
Liam: Add a dashboard review item — latency/99pct + cost delta since the last deploy. Also propose a short demo of the KV cache fix we rolled last week.
OnboardBot: Helix Health onboarding status: 60% complete. Blockers: S3 access + schema mismatch on events pipeline. Assigned: eng-contacts. Next milestone: test env by 2024-11-08.
Maya: Thanks — we'll include blockers on the agenda and aim to clear S3 access during the session if eng can join. @Sam can you coordinate eng attendance?
Sam: Yup, I'll ping eng-infra and @Jordan for the dashboard walkthrough. Will also prep the migration checklist.
Jordan: Draft agenda below — please nudge.
Sam: ```
Invite: Helix Primary + NovaCare PMs, AMs, CS admins
Duration: 60m
Agenda:
- 5m quick intros
- 15m migration triage (Sam)
- 15m perf/dashboard walkthrough (Jordan)
```

Priya: For feedback capture let's use the short Notion template and 2-minute pulse at the end. Notion link: https://notion.so/rw/ambassador-oh-feedback
Liam: +1. Also ask them to complete this 3-question post-session form (I'll paste after we confirm time).
Maya: Can we do a 15m pre-call with the AM 30m before main session to surface renewal concerns? Who can join? @Jordan @Priya
Jordan: I can do pre-call. I'll pull perf logs and the recent evals.
Priya: I'll take notes and capture next steps in Notion during the meeting.
Sam: Confirmed — I'll reserve Tue 10am PT and send calendar invite once we hit majority reactions. Tentative room: Zoom ID 834-555-019.
Maya: Great. If anyone cannot make Tue 10am, say so now. Otherwise I'll mark this as confirmed in 1h.
Liam: One more ask — add a short section on cost mitigation (batching + quant suggestion) so Helix has concrete next steps.
Maya: Noted. Thanks all. I'll post invite and link to the feedback form once Sam confirms eng attendance. :rocket:
